description: Source code for SecureWebServer class implementing an SSL-enabled web server in an Android environment, including SSL context setup, socket handling, and serving a simple HTML page with embedded base64 image.

classes.name: SecureWebServer
classes.description: A class that implements a simple SSL web server for Android, capable of serving a static HTML page with an embedded image.

methods.name: SecureWebServer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes SSL context and prepares the server with a base64 image.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the web server on port 8080 in a new thread, handling incoming SSL connections and serving HTML content.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the web server and closes the socket.

methods.name: createBase64Image
methods.description: Reads an image from assets, encodes it in base64, and returns the string.
